snippets.snippet_text: > "The standard Mollie fee for online credit card transactions ranges from 1.80% + €0.25 to 2.90% + €0.25 per transaction for European Economic Area consumer credit cards from Mastercard and Visa. Rates vary by payment methods, please check Mollie's pricing page for the latest updates. Note that these fees are collected by Mollie and do not go to Payhip."

> "Mollie is currently supported in over 20 countries including Austria, Belgium, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, and United Kingdom."

possible_subjects: Payhip help center article on Mollie payment processor integration (last updated February 22, 2026): Mollie transaction fees for EEA Mastercard/Visa consumer credit cards range from 1.80%+€0.25 to 2.90%+€0.25 per transaction; Mollie supported in 20+ European countries (Austria, Belgium, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, UK); Mollie fees go to Mollie, not Payhip
